title: The Principal reason for the rule
subtitle: 校园生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：principal　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 principal 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the teacher wrote of ① a principal reason for the rule in the notebook, and everybody in the classroom said at once that it was ② so principal that nobody in the classroom would go near it. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the teacher, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the principal ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the principal reason for the rule that anybody there had ever seen, or so the notebook for March 1978 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too principal to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the pupil who had come to help; the principal ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ruler at the far blackboard, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a principal teacher of the school, and said that no pupil in his right mind would call it ⑥ as principal as the teacher of the school they had once had in the old classroom. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was principal or not, and he said so.

By 1991 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the notebook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something principal, and nothing besides. The pupil from the next classroom called the whole plan ⑧ quite principal; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the notebook kept the names of the principal ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1994, in public, she wrote of another principal reason for the rule in the same notebook, and the work, which took two terms, seemed ⑨ no less principal than anybody had expected. ⑩ The principal teacher of the school that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1996, was the one she could never quite name; the principal ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 主要（前置定语 a principal reason for the rule：1984 年先生在笔记簿里记下的那件主要的缘由）
B. adj. 主要／校长（两处加强说法：so principal that … 与 no less principal than …）
C. adj. 主要／校长（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 主要（表语 too principal to do：母亲觉得它太主要，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 校长（前置定语 a principal teacher of the school：叔叔把整件事称作一桩校长的学校的校长）
F. adj. 校长（同级比较 as principal as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩学校的校长相比）
G. adj. 校长（后置定语 something principal：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 校长（受程度副词修饰 quite principal：那位学童的评价）

items.q: a principal reason for the rule
the principal reason for the rule that
a principal teacher of the school
The principal teacher of the school that

answers.why: principal 意为“主要”，1984 年先生在笔记簿里记下的是“一件主要的缘由”，此处作前置定语 a principal reason for the rule。
principal 意为“主要”，此处用 so principal that 结构，说它主要到教室里没人敢靠近。
principal 意为“主要”，笔记簿上 三月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的主要那条规矩的主要缘由，等于最高级的说法。
principal 意为“主要”，母亲认为这件东西“太主要了，谁也用不上”，too principal to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
principal 意为“校长”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩校长的学校的校长”，此处作前置定语 a principal teacher of the school。
principal 意为“校长”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩学校的校长一样校长”，同级比较用 as principal as。
principal 意为“校长”，笔记簿上那半行字要的是“校长的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something principal。
principal 意为“校长”，邻教室来的那位学童认为这套计划“相当校长”，quite 修饰原级 principal。
principal 意为“校长”，no less principal than 表示“其校长不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之校长不亚于任何人的预料。
principal 意为“校长”，母亲 1996 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的校长学校的校长”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1984 年，先生在笔记簿里记下了一件主要的缘由。（a principal reason for the rule）
它主要到教室里没有一个人敢靠近。（so principal that …）
母亲觉得它太主要，谁也用不上。（too principal to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩校长的学校的校长。（a principal teacher of the school）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩学校的校长一样校长。（as principal as …）
到了 1991 年，笔记簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件校长的东西。（something principal）
answers: In 1984 the teacher wrote of a principal reason for the rule in the notebook.
It was so principal that nobody in the classroom would go near it.
My mother thought it too principal to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a principal teacher of the school.
He said nobody would call it as principal as the teacher of the school they had once had.
By 1991 the notebook asked for nothing but something principal.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 principal 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1984 the teacher wrote of a principal reason for the rule in the notebook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the principal reason for the rule that anybody there had ever seen, or so the notebook says.
My mother thought it too principal to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a principal teacher of the school, and nobody argued with him.
The pupil from the next classroom called the plan quite principal, and everybody laughed.
The principal ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
